title: Testimony to Ross Coulthart in Washington DC

tellings.quote: made contact with uh Ross Cohart and uh flew down to DC, met with Ross,

plain: A man named Jordan Jose, who says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child, says that in 2024 he contacted Ross Coulthart, a journalist who reports on UFOs, flew to Washington, DC, and met him there to tell his story. Jose tells Michels this himself. He also mentions David Grusch, a former Air Force intelligence officer who has said publicly that the US government holds craft not made by humans, which places his account among the whistleblowers who have come forward.
